name: jev-normalization
description: Jev normalization conformance cases. One adapter normalizes one response of the pinned SDK into exactly one typed assessment with its operational record, or into one operational failure that names the defect. Every case drives the adapter through the dispatch contract, so the Rust core validates each normalized assessment against its check before it can enter one report. The group is mandatory for the TypeScript SDK and for the later Python SDK, whose native adapter must produce the same assessments and the same failures. Each response answers its question under the check identifier of the case: one real response echoes the key of the request, and the adapter keys its one question by the check identifier, so the provider answer key of the source record is renamed to the check identifier and nothing else changes.

rules.choice: The selected label crosses as label, the probabilities over every declared label become the distribution in the declared order, and one reported confidence crosses as confidence.
rules.noul: The noul value is the probability of yes. One half or more selects yes; less selects no. Noul defines no confidence, so one confidence field in one response is consumed by nothing and the assessment holds no confidence and no derived distribution.
rules.score: The position crosses unrounded, the nearest level names the answer, and the distribution maps the level indices to the declared level names in the declared order. The legend is one echo of the sent descriptions and is consumed by nothing.
rules.tie: One tie selects the answer with the greater position: one Noul value of one half selects yes, and one Score position halfway between two levels selects the higher level.
rules.operational_record: The record keeps the response model as model_resolved, the per-request token usage as usage, and the adapter-measured call time as latency_ms. No response field states latency, so the adapter measures it. No per-question usage exists, so usage stays at request level.

cases.note: One Choice answer becomes one categorical assessment with the selected label, the distribution over every declared label, and the reported confidence.
